Luciano Paredes and Luciano Cingolani were both cautioned by the referee as Gimnasia Mendoza struggled to break through a resilient defensive block. After five minutes of added time, the final whistle confirmed a disciplined performance from Defensa y Justicia , who successfully managed the game to claim all three points.
